hero.title: Travel & Stay
hero.subtitle: Accommodation & Delegate Hospitality
hero.description: Support for international delegates attending the 5th Coast Guard Global Summit — official hotels, airport assistance, and ground transportation arranged by the CGGS Secretariat.

overview.intro: The CGGS 2027 Secretariat has made comprehensive arrangements to ensure a seamless experience for all official delegates, media representatives, and participating nations. From official accommodation and airport reception to dedicated liaison officers and curated hospitality — every detail has been professionally coordinated for this landmark international summit in Chennai.

cards.title: Official Hotels
cards.description: Five-star partner hotels designated by the Secretariat for delegate accommodation, with dedicated summit liaison desks and priority check-in.

cards.title: Airport Assistance
cards.description: Official reception at Chennai International Airport with immigration guidance, dedicated pickup counters, and multilingual liaison officers.

cards.title: Transportation
cards.description: Coordinated airport pickups, hotel transfers, summit shuttles, and dedicated transport for Fleet Review and official events.

cards.title: Hospitality
cards.description: Curated meal arrangements including breakfast, working lunches, official receptions, and the CGGS 2027 Gala Dinner.

cards.title: Liaison Officers
cards.description: Country-assigned liaison officers available 24/7 to assist delegates with travel, protocol, and on-ground coordination throughout the summit.

venue.name: ITC Grand Chola — Rajendra Chola Hall
venue.address: 63, Anna Salai (Mount Road), Guindy, Chennai 600032, Tamil Nadu, India

airport.name: Chennai International Airport
airport.arrival_terminal: International Arrivals — Terminal 4 (T4). Follow signage to the Arrivals Hall after immigration and baggage collection.
airport.immigration_guidance: Delegates travelling on official CGGS invitation should carry their invitation letter and passport. A dedicated CGGS immigration facilitation desk will be available in the International Arrivals area during summit dates (14–18 February 2027).
airport.taxi_information: Pre-paid taxi counters are located in the Arrivals Hall. Official delegates are strongly advised to use CGGS-arranged pickup services rather than independent taxis.
airport.official_pickup_counter: CGGS Official Pickup Counter — International Arrivals Hall, near Exit Gate 3. Look for the CGGS 2027 signage and Indian Coast Guard liaison officers holding country nameplates.
arrival_tips: Complete your arrival details in the Delegate Portal at least 72 hours before travel.
Carry a printed or digital copy of your CGGS invitation letter for immigration.
Proceed directly to the CGGS Official Pickup Counter — do not accept unsolicited transport offers.
Liaison officers will display your country nameplate at the designated meeting point.
Allow 45–60 minutes for immigration and baggage collection during peak arrival windows.

transport.intro: The CGGS Secretariat operates a coordinated ground transportation network for all official delegates. From airport reception to summit venues and official events, dedicated vehicles and trained drivers ensure safe, punctual, and protocol-appropriate travel throughout your stay.

services.title: Official Shuttle Services
services.description: Scheduled shuttle services between official hotels and the summit venue during session hours.

services.title: Airport Pickup
services.description: Pre-arranged meet-and-greet at Chennai International Airport with dedicated vehicles for each delegation.

services.title: Hotel Transfers
services.description: Point-to-point transfers between official hotels and all summit venues, including late-evening return services.

services.title: Fleet Review Transport
services.description: Dedicated convoy transport to Chennai Port Trust and Marina viewing areas for the International Fleet Review.

services.title: Seminar Transportation
services.description: Coordinated transport for World Coast Guard Seminar sessions and associated working group meetings.

meals.intro: The CGGS Secretariat has arranged comprehensive hospitality for all official delegates throughout the summit period. Meal services are coordinated across official hotels and summit venues to accommodate diverse dietary requirements and protocol seating arrangements.

items.title: Breakfast
items.description: Complimentary breakfast at official hotels from 06:30–09:30 IST during the summit period.

items.title: Lunch
items.description: Working lunches served at summit venues on Days 1–3, with vegetarian and international options.

items.title: Dinner
items.description: Curated dinner arrangements at official hotels and designated summit dining venues.

items.title: Coffee Breaks
items.description: Refreshment breaks during all plenary sessions, seminars, and working group meetings.

items.title: Official Reception
items.description: Welcome reception hosted by the Indian Coast Guard on the evening of 15 February 2027.

items.title: Gala Dinner
items.description: CGGS 2027 Gala Dinner — a landmark evening celebrating 50 years of the Indian Coast Guard.

meals.login_note: Personalised meal schedules, seating arrangements, and detailed menus are available exclusively through the Delegate Portal after registration confirmation.

important_info.title: Visa Guidance
important_info.description: Official delegates should apply for an Indian Conference Visa (e-Conference Visa available for eligible nationalities). The Secretariat will provide supporting invitation letters upon registration approval.

important_info.title: Travel Advisory
important_info.description: Chennai is a major metropolitan city with excellent connectivity. Delegates are advised to arrive by 14 February 2027 for pre-summit coordination meetings.

important_info.title: Security Guidelines
important_info.description: All summit venues operate under enhanced security protocols coordinated with Tamil Nadu Police and Central Armed Police Forces. Valid delegate credentials are required for venue access.

important_info.title: Dress Code
important_info.description: Business formal for plenary sessions and seminars. National dress or service uniform for official ceremonies. Black tie / national formal for the Gala Dinner.

important_info.title: Weather
important_info.description: February in Chennai: 24–32°C, partly cloudy with occasional light showers. Light cotton formal wear recommended. Humidity levels moderate.

important_info.title: Medical Support
important_info.description: On-site medical teams at all summit venues. Apollo Hospitals (Guindy) is the designated emergency facility, 3 km from the principal venue.
